$comment: Exemptions from the contrast-matrix pair registry (tools/contrast/pairs.mjs). Every entry needs `reason` and `owner`; the gate prints this full list on every run (docs/plan/16-design-system-brief.md#11, ticket E05-T05 technical notes) so exemptions cannot quietly accumulate.

exemptions.reason: Pressed-state fill of the primary button. Its label pairing (color.text.on-action, 4.5:1), its lightness step from the other states and its hue are gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.

Hover-state fill of the primary button. Its label pairing (color.text.on-action, 4.5:1), its lightness step from the other states and its hue are gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.

Hover-state fill of the secondary button. Its label pairing (color.text.primary, 4.5:1) and its lightness step from the rest fill are gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.
Decorative-only divider tier one step below color.border.default (which is declared); explicitly not meaning-carrying so WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast does not apply.

Hover-state fill of the buy button. Its label pairing (color.text.inverse, 4.5:1), its lightness step from color.buy.default and its hue are gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.

Low-emphasis background tint (chip/badge fill) always paired with color.buy.default text on top, per docs/plan/05-accessibility-standard.md #4's shape+text+colour triad; the fill itself carries no independent text.
Low-emphasis background tint, same rationale as color.buy.subtle/color.sell.subtle.

Hover-state fill of the sell button. Its label pairing (color.text.inverse, 4.5:1), its lightness step from color.sell.default and its hue are gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.
Low-emphasis background tint, same rationale as color.buy.subtle.
Low-emphasis status background tint always paired with the corresponding *.strong text token (already declared).
WCAG 1.4.3/1.4.11 explicitly exempt disabled/inactive UI component text and controls from the contrast requirement.

Label and glyph colour on filled controls (the buy and sell buttons among them), never a standalone text-on-surface colour; its pairing with every buy and sell state fill is gated by the label-on-fill matrix (tools/contrast/label-on-fill.json, #3896) rather than this pair registry.
